# Setup
 
The following chunks set up the activity.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Make sure the dataset is in the same folder as this notebook
filename <- "GaltonsFamilyHeights.txt"
df_raw <- read_table(filename)
```

```{r}
df_data <- 
  df_raw %>% 
  mutate(across(-gender, as.numeric))
df_data
```


```{r}
df_data %>% 
  filter(gender %in% c("male", "female")) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(midparentHeight, childHeight, color = gender)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", linetype = "dashed", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Child") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.1),
    aspect.ratio = 0.75,
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Parent Mid-Height (in)",
    y = "Child Height (in)",
    caption = "Mid-height is the average of mother and father heights."
  )
```

# Regression

Modify the formula below to change the regression model.

```{r}
df_data %>% 
  lm(
    # Modify the regression formula to change the model
    formula = childHeight ~ father + mother + gender
  ) %>% 
  summary()
df_data %>% 
  lm(
    # Modify the regression formula to change the model
    formula = childHeight ~ midparentHeight + gender
  ) %>% 
  summary()
```
